quest.title: Yachimatahime's Trial
quest.description: Accepting the trial, you prepare to go to the Evernight Temple to search for The Emanant Skylight

talks.objective: Investigate the water in the pool during Evernight
Talk to the afterimage in front of the seal

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: I am Eki of the Jibashiri. Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: I am in charge of the trial of "insight." Go forth and solve all the puzzles to return the Flames of the High Gate to their respective places.

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: The battlefield is ever-changing. Only by keeping your eyes and ears wide open at all times may you grasp the situation and master all these variables.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: Have you completed the challenge, hero of Sangonomiya?

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: Use your insight and find all the Flames of the High Gate!

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: Impressive. You cleared that trial with ease. I, Eki of the Jibashiri, acknowledge your great valor.

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: Your insight can be said to be sufficient to seek out an eel in the winter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what's that supposed to mean, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: Breeding season unagi fry are very, very small. You must exert the greatest visual acuity to see them.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Eki
dialogues.text: I am Eki of the Jibashiri. If you are here on unimportant affairs, depart from this place.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate
